context: Two cafe friends compare weekend music and salon plans
purpose: Teach: ポピュラー/弾く/バナー/甲子園/歯医者/カール/楽章/美女

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 週末ね、久しぶりにピアノを弾くつもりなんだ。第一楽章だけだけど。
lines.en: This weekend, I'm planning to play piano for the first time in a while—just the first movement, though.
lines.style: Warm, casual barista voice with gentle enthusiasm and a soft trailing tone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 素敵！私はね、ポピュラー音楽のフェスに行くの。駅にバナー広告が出てたやつ。
lines.en: Lovely! Me, I'm going to that pop music festival—the one with banner ads at the station.
lines.style: Dreamy, romantic delivery with bright upward inflection and excited pacing throughout.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: あ、知ってる。ちょうど甲子園の中継と日が重なるから、彼はテレビ派かも。
lines.en: Oh, I know it. It overlaps with the Koshien broadcast, so my boyfriend might be team TV instead.
lines.style: Conversational and knowing, with a small chuckle and relaxed shoulders feel.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: あはは。あ、そういえば日曜は歯医者の予約も入ってて、午後だけ自由なの。
lines.en: Haha. Oh, that reminds me—I've got a dentist appointment Sunday, so only the afternoon's free.
lines.style: Light laugh leading into a slightly apologetic, planning-aloud tone with gentle warmth.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: じゃあその前にサロン寄らない？髪をカールしてもらうとフェス映えするよ。
lines.en: Then how about stopping by the salon beforehand? Getting your hair curled looks great at festivals.
lines.style: Suggestive and friendly, with a playful lilt and barista-style attentive warmth.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: それいいね！絶世の美女になって帰ってくる、なんてね。
lines.en: Ooh, that's perfect! I'll come back transformed into a stunning beauty—just kidding.
lines.style: Self-teasing, sing-song delivery with a giggle on the punchline and bright energy.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: もう十分美女だって。じゃあ土曜の朝、店の前で待ち合わせね。
lines.en: You're already plenty beautiful. Then Saturday morning, let's meet up in front of the shop.
lines.style: Affectionate and grounded, with a soft compliment and decisive plan-making tone.
